purpose: Verify that HR-EIS enforces Fusion-assigned RBAC across module functions, respects institutional control of role assignments, and restricts unauthorized access or data modification.
preconditions: Fusion RBAC configured with distinct accounts: HR Administrator, Employee, Approving Authorities (HOD, Registrar, Director), and Accountant.
action_or_input: Authenticate as each role and attempt authorized and unauthorized operations across HR-EIS endpoints (viewing records, creating service records, submitting requests, approving requests).
expected_result: Authorized roles are permitted to perform their respective designated operations; unauthorized roles are blocked from sensitive and employee-specific data with access refusal (403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify that an Employee can initiate supported HR service requests and track the status of requests submitted by the Employee.
preconditions: Active authenticated Employee user account in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Submit a valid HR service request (e.g., leave, LTC, CPDA) as an Employee and subsequently query the request status tracking interface.
expected_result: Request is successfully submitted, assigned a pending status, and visible with its lifecycle progression in the Employee's request tracking list.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS selects and enforces applicable approval authority routing by employee category and request type, supports Approved/Rejected/Forwarded outcomes, and prevents workflow bypass or alterations.
preconditions: Configured approval workflows for faculty and non-teaching staff; pending HR requests awaiting authority review.
action_or_input: Route request through designated approval sequence (HOD, Registrar, Director); execute valid transitions (Approve, Reject, Forward) and attempt out-of-order authority actions.
expected_result: Requests route strictly according to employee category and request type; valid actions advance the workflow or finalize status; out-of-order or unauthorized authority bypass attempts are rejected.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS provides the HR Administrator with authorized capabilities to manage service records, verify HR requests, configure workflow settings, assign reviewers, and monitor audits.
preconditions: Authenticated user holding the HR Administrator role in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Execute HR Administrator operational actions: update an employee service record, verify submitted LTC/CPDA documentation, configure in-scope workflow parameters, assign an appraisal reviewer, and inspect audit logs.
expected_result: All operational actions execute successfully with changes persisted, verified, and logged.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the Accountant to verify financial correctness, process approved LTC and CPDA claims, and record external payment or disbursement status.
preconditions: Authenticated user holding the Accountant role; approved LTC and CPDA claims ready for financial settlement in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: As Accountant, verify financial amounts, mark claims processed for financial settlement, and record payment/disbursement statuses received from external payroll or finance systems.
expected_result: Financial correctness check succeeds, claim status updates to processed/disbursed, and settlement details are auditable in HR-EIS.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS maintains a centralized service record for each employee, restricts creation/modification to HR Administrators, allows Employees read-only access to their own record, and preserves record consistency.
preconditions: Centralized employee service records populated in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: HR Administrator updates service record attributes; Employee attempts to view own record, view another employee's record, and modify own record.
expected_result: HR Administrator updates succeed atomically; Employee successfully views own record in read-only mode; Employee attempts to view another's record or alter official records are refused.

purpose: Verify the complete leave management lifecycle including leave application for supported types, mandatory field validation, balance validation, approval routing, automated balance deduction, and transaction logging.
preconditions: Active Employee with initialized leave balances; designated Approving Authority.
action_or_input: Employee submits a leave request with leave type, duration, and justification; Approving Authority approves the leave request.
expected_result: Submission validates balance and eligibility; on approval, employee leave balance is automatically decremented and the transaction is permanently logged.

purpose: Verify the yearly appraisal lifecycle including submission within configured windows, reviewer assignment, authority evaluation, service record archival, and post-closure immutability.
preconditions: Active appraisal submission window configured; authenticated Employee, HR Administrator, and appraisal Reviewer.
action_or_input: Employee submits yearly appraisal form; HR Administrator assigns reviewer; reviewer evaluates and authority finalizes; verify archival in service record and attempt post-closure edit.
expected_result: Appraisal is submitted, reviewed, finalized, and archived in the employee service record; post-closure modification attempts are rejected.

purpose: Verify the complete LTC lifecycle including advance and reimbursement requests on prescribed forms, HR verification, approval routing, Accountant processing, payment status recording, and audit history preservation.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee, HR Administrator, Approving Authority, and Accountant.
action_or_input: Employee submits LTC advance/reimbursement request; HR Administrator verifies documentation and eligibility; Authority approves; Accountant processes and records payment status; inspect audit trail on rejection/return.
expected_result: LTC request moves through verification, approval, and settlement stages; payment status is linked to payroll records; rejected/returned requests retain complete audit history.

purpose: Verify the complete CPDA lifecycle including advance/reimbursement submission with required purpose, amount, and documents, HR verification, approval routing, Accountant processing, and auditable disbursement recording.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee, HR Administrator, Approving Authority, and Accountant.
action_or_input: Employee submits CPDA claim with purpose, amount, and attachments; HR Administrator verifies claim; Authority approves; Accountant records disbursement.
expected_result: CPDA request validates required elements, advances through verification and approval hierarchy, and records auditable disbursement details.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS generates and exposes notifications for request submissions, workflow decisions (approval, rejection, forwarding), pending action reminders, and policy/deadline updates across dashboard and email delivery paths.
preconditions: Configured notification triggers and active user accounts.
action_or_input: Trigger request submission, workflow approval/rejection/forwarding events, pending action reminders, and policy updates; inspect generated notifications.
expected_result: Appropriate notifications are generated for target recipients and dispatched to dashboard notification feeds and email delivery interfaces.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS logs all HR transactions with actor identity, timestamp, and action performed, enforces log immutability and role-restricted access, and supports compliance review.
preconditions: HR transactions executed in the system; authenticated HR Administrator and unauthorized Employee account.
action_or_input: Execute an HR action; inspect created audit log entry; attempt to edit or delete the audit entry; attempt access as unauthorized Employee.
expected_result: Audit entry captures actor identity, timestamp, and action; log modification/deletion is prevented; unauthorized access is refused; HR Administrator can view logs for compliance review.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS exchanges claim payment/disbursement statuses with payroll systems, accounting statuses with finance systems, and identity/role information with Fusion modules without owning external execution semantics.
preconditions: Configured integration status synchronization interfaces for payroll, finance, and platform identity.
action_or_input: Simulate status exchange events for approved claims with payroll and finance, and query identity consistency with platform modules.
expected_result: HR-EIS records external status synchronization accurately in real time where configured, while leaving external payroll and financial execution semantics outside HR-EIS.

purpose: Verify the architectural scope boundary that HR-EIS does not modify external payroll rules or salary structures during HR financial claim recording and exchange.
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke operations to alter payroll calculation rules or modify institute salary structure definitions via HR-EIS interfaces.
expected_result: HR-EIS provides no endpoints or functionality to modify payroll rules or salary structures; operations are refused or unsupported, preserving external domain integrity.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS operates under Fusion RBAC for actor permissions across all module endpoints.
preconditions: Authenticated session with assigned Fusion RBAC roles (Employee, HR Administrator, Accountant, Approving Authorities).
action_or_input: Access HR-EIS module views and API endpoints with role-appropriate permissions.
expected_result: HR-EIS verifies assigned RBAC permissions and permits access only when required role/permission is present.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS enforces Fusion RBAC for all HR-EIS functional actions.
preconditions: Authenticated users with specific functional permissions.
action_or_input: Execute HR-EIS functions (leave application, verification, approval, settlement) and verify role validation.
expected_result: Functional actions are permitted only for users whose assigned roles match required permissions for the action.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports users holding multiple roles simultaneously (e.g., Faculty Employee who is also HOD).
preconditions: User account assigned both 'Employee' and 'HOD' (Approving Authority) roles.
action_or_input: Authenticate as the multi-role user; submit a personal leave request as an Employee, then switch context/act as HOD to review a departmental request.
expected_result: System correctly recognizes both role entitlements; user can perform both self-service employee actions and authority approval actions.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows role assignment only by institutional authorities and rejects routine HR actor attempts.
preconditions: Authenticated regular Employee session and institutional authority session.
action_or_input: Regular Employee attempts to assign HR-EIS roles; institutional authority assigns an HR-EIS role via platform RBAC.
expected_result: Employee attempt to assign roles is refused (403 Forbidden); institutional authority assignment succeeds.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows role reassignment only by institutional authorities.
preconditions: Existing role assignments in the platform; regular user and institutional authority accounts.
action_or_input: Regular Employee attempts to reassign an HR authority role; institutional authority reassigns the role.
expected_result: Unauthorized role reassignment is blocked (403 Forbidden); institutional authority reassignment is processed.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS restricts access to sensitive HR data to authorized roles only.
preconditions: Sensitive HR records (e.g. employee master records, confidential appraisal reviews) exist in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt access to sensitive records using an unauthorized actor role.
expected_result: HR-EIS blocks unauthorized access with 403 Forbidden, preserving data confidentiality and prior valid state.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS restricts Employees to accessing only their own employee data.
preconditions: Employee A and Employee B exist with separate service and request records.
action_or_input: Employee A submits a request to view or query Employee B's personal service records or request details.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden; Employee A cannot access Employee B's private employee data.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents unauthorized access to HR-EIS data by unauthenticated or anonymous actors.
preconditions: Unauthenticated request context (no valid authentication credentials or session token).
action_or_input: Attempt to access protected HR-EIS endpoints (service records, leave requests, appraisals).
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects the request with 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden, preventing access to HR data.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents unauthorized modification of HR-EIS data.
preconditions: Existing HR-EIS records (leave request, service record, financial claim).
action_or_input: User without modification rights attempts POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE on existing HR-EIS records.
expected_result: Modification attempt is blocked with 403 Forbidden; target data remains unaltered in its prior valid state.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows an Employee to submit HR-related service requests.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with valid profile.
action_or_input: Employee initiates and submits a valid HR request (leave, LTC, CPDA, or appraisal).
expected_result: HR-EIS accepts the submission, validates payload, stores the request in pending state, and returns success (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows an Employee to track statuses of HR-related requests submitted by the Employee.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with several previously submitted HR requests in various states (Pending, Approved, Rejected).
action_or_input: Employee requests the list and detail views of their submitted HR requests.
expected_result: HR-EIS returns all requests submitted by the Employee along with accurate real-time statuses and progression history.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes department-level approvals to the Head of Department (HOD) where applicable.
preconditions: Employee in a department submits an HR request requiring departmental approval; HOD account exists.
action_or_input: Submit request and check the designated pending authority assignment.
expected_result: Request is routed to the HOD's approval queue for department-level review.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes non-teaching staff approvals to the Registrar where applicable.
preconditions: Non-teaching staff employee submits an HR request requiring institute administrative review; Registrar account exists.
action_or_input: Submit non-teaching staff request and verify the assigned approval authority.
expected_result: Request is routed to the Registrar's approval queue according to non-teaching staff routing rules.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes faculty-level or final authority approvals to the Director where applicable.
preconditions: Faculty member submits an HR request requiring directorate approval (e.g., sabbatical leave, special entitlement); Director account exists.
action_or_input: Submit faculty-level request and inspect the assigned approving authority.
expected_result: Request is routed to the Director's approval queue for executive review.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS determines approval authority strictly by employee category and request type.
preconditions: Configured approval matrix mapping combinations of (Faculty, Non-Teaching) and (Leave, LTC, CPDA, Appraisal) to authorities.
action_or_input: Submit distinct requests varying employee category and request type; observe the authority assigned.
expected_result: Approval authority is determined strictly by the category-request type matrix without arbitrary routing.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes all HR requests through configured rule-based workflows.
preconditions: HR requests submitted across various modules (Leave, LTC, CPDA).
action_or_input: Submit requests and inspect the workflow execution path from initial submission through sequential states.
expected_result: All requests follow deterministic rule-based state transitions according to workflow rules.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports the request outcome or transition: Approved.
preconditions: Pending request assigned to an Approving Authority.
action_or_input: Approving Authority executes the 'Approve' action on the pending request.
expected_result: Request status transitions to Approved, triggers downstream events (e.g. balance deduction or accountant handoff), and records decision.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports the request outcome or transition: Rejected.
preconditions: Pending request assigned to an Approving Authority.
action_or_input: Approving Authority executes the 'Reject' action on the pending request with required justification.
expected_result: Request status transitions to Rejected, workflow terminates, audit record is preserved, and applicant is notified.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports the request outcome or transition: Forwarded to next authority.
preconditions: Multi-tier request currently at intermediate authority level (e.g. HOD review before Director).
action_or_input: Intermediate authority executes the 'Forward' action on the pending request.
expected_result: Request status transitions to Forwarded, and request is queued to the next designated authority in the hierarchy.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS enforces authority roles using RBAC during HR request workflows.
preconditions: Request pending review by specific authority role (e.g. Registrar); user without that role.
action_or_input: User without Registrar role attempts to approve or reject the request pending Registrar review.
expected_result: Action is refused with 403 Forbidden; only users with the specific assigned authority role can decide the request.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents any authority from bypassing workflow order.
preconditions: Multi-stage request currently awaiting stage 1 approval (e.g. HOD); stage 2 authority (Director) account.
action_or_input: Stage 2 authority attempts to approve or decide the request before stage 1 authority has acted.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects the out-of-order action with an error (400 Bad Request or 403 Forbidden), preserving stage 1 pending state.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents any authority from altering workflow order.
preconditions: Active configured workflow path for an HR request.
action_or_input: Authority attempts to dynamically redirect, skip an intermediate authority, or re-sequence workflow steps during request processing.
expected_result: Modification of workflow order during processing is blocked; request adheres strictly to the configured sequence.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS does not allow manual bypass of configured approval workflows.
preconditions: Submitted HR request in pending approval state.
action_or_input: Actor attempts to manually force request state directly to 'Approved' or 'Disbursed' without executing prescribed workflow steps.
expected_result: Direct manual bypass is blocked; state changes require legitimate authority decisions via workflow endpoints.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the HR Administrator to manage employee master and service records.
preconditions: Authenticated HR Administrator user account.
action_or_input: HR Administrator creates a new employee master record or updates service record attributes (designation, department).
expected_result: Operation is accepted and persisted with 200 OK or 201 Created.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the HR Administrator to verify submitted HR requests (documentation and eligibility).
preconditions: Submitted LTC or CPDA request pending HR Administrator verification.
action_or_input: HR Administrator reviews documentation and executes 'Verify' action on the request.
expected_result: Verification is recorded, request transitions to 'Verified' state, and moves to approval routing.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the HR Administrator to configure HR workflows where configuration is within HR-EIS scope.
preconditions: Authenticated HR Administrator user account.
action_or_input: HR Administrator updates in-scope workflow settings (e.g. appraisal submission window dates, reminder trigger thresholds).
expected_result: Workflow configuration parameters are successfully updated and applied to subsequent workflow executions.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the HR Administrator to assign reviewers for appraisal evaluation.
preconditions: Submitted appraisal form awaiting reviewer assignment; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator assigns designated faculty/authority reviewers to the submitted appraisal.
expected_result: Reviewer assignment is successfully recorded and the appraisal becomes actionable in the assigned reviewer's queue.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the HR Administrator to monitor compliance and audits using authorized HR-EIS records.
preconditions: Authenticated HR Administrator; historical HR transaction logs exist.
action_or_input: HR Administrator accesses audit and compliance query interfaces.
expected_result: System returns authorized audit logs and compliance history filtered by date, actor, or transaction type.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the Accountant to process approved LTC claims for financial settlement recording.
preconditions: Approved LTC claim awaiting settlement; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant accesses approved LTC claim and records financial settlement processing.
expected_result: LTC claim status is updated to processed for settlement, and settlement details are saved.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the Accountant to process approved CPDA claims for financial settlement recording.
preconditions: Approved CPDA claim awaiting settlement; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant accesses approved CPDA claim and records financial settlement processing.
expected_result: CPDA claim status is updated to processed for settlement, and settlement details are saved.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the Accountant to verify financial correctness of LTC and CPDA claims.
preconditions: Approved claim with submitted expenditure bills; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant performs financial correctness check and verifies amounts against entitlement rules.
expected_result: Accountant verification is recorded; claim proceeds to settlement recording if valid or flagged if discrepant.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS records payment or disbursement status for approved financial claims when received from payroll or finance systems.
preconditions: Processed LTC/CPDA claim in HR-EIS; external integration payment status notification.
action_or_input: Receive payment/disbursement status payload from payroll or finance system for the claim.
expected_result: HR-EIS updates claim payment status (e.g. Disbursed/Paid) with external reference and timestamp.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows an Employee to view the Employee's own service records.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with existing service record.
action_or_input: Employee navigates to personal service record view.
expected_result: HR-EIS displays the Employee's personal service record details.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS maintains a centralized service record for each employee.
preconditions: Employee profiles loaded into HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Query employee service record by employee ID from the centralized data store.
expected_result: A unique authoritative service record is retrieved containing all core employee information.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS includes appointment details in the employee service record.
preconditions: Employee service record created with appointment metadata (date of joining, appointment type).
action_or_input: Retrieve employee service record data.
expected_result: Service record payload explicitly includes appointment details.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS includes department in the employee service record.
preconditions: Employee service record created with assigned department.
action_or_input: Retrieve employee service record data.
expected_result: Service record payload explicitly includes the department attribute.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS includes designation in the employee service record.
preconditions: Employee service record created with assigned designation.
action_or_input: Retrieve employee service record data.
expected_result: Service record payload explicitly includes the designation attribute.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS includes service history in the employee service record.
preconditions: Employee service record with historical promotions, transfers, or increments.
action_or_input: Retrieve employee service record data.
expected_result: Service record payload includes the complete service history chronology.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS includes leave balances in the employee service record.
preconditions: Employee service record initialized with leave balances across categories.
action_or_input: Retrieve employee service record data.
expected_result: Service record payload explicitly includes current leave balances.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS includes retirement status in the employee service record.
preconditions: Employee service record created with retirement eligibility date and status.
action_or_input: Retrieve employee service record data.
expected_result: Service record payload explicitly includes retirement status and retirement date.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS restricts creation of employee service records to HR Administrators and blocks other actors.
preconditions: Authenticated non-HR-Admin account (e.g. Employee, Approving Authority).
action_or_input: Attempt to create a new employee service record via POST endpoint.
expected_result: Creation is refused with 403 Forbidden; only HR Administrator is permitted to create service records.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS restricts modification of employee service records to HR Administrators and blocks other actors.
preconditions: Existing employee service record; authenticated non-HR-Admin account.
action_or_input: Attempt to update an existing employee service record via PUT/PATCH endpoint.
expected_result: Modification is refused with 403 Forbidden; service record remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Employees to view their own service records in read-only mode.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee accessing their own service record.
action_or_input: Employee queries service record via GET endpoint.
expected_result: Employee successfully retrieves service record details with read-only permissions (no edit capabilities afforded).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS preserves service record consistency during updates.
preconditions: Existing employee service record; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: Execute valid multi-field update on service record (department change and designation update).
expected_result: Update is applied consistently across all record relations with no orphan or contradictory data.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents partial updates from corrupting service records.
preconditions: Existing employee service record; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: Submit an update payload containing a mix of valid fields and an invalid/faulty field that triggers an internal validation failure.
expected_result: Transaction rolls back entirely; no partial field updates are written; service record retains its prior valid state.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS does not permit Employees to alter official service records.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee session.
action_or_input: Employee submits a PATCH/PUT request attempting to alter designation or service history on their own service record.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden; official record data cannot be modified by the employee.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Employees to apply for leave requests.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with available leave balance.
action_or_input: Employee submits a complete and valid leave request payload.
expected_result: Leave request is accepted and created with status 'Pending' (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports Casual leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with Casual leave balance.
action_or_input: Submit leave request specifying leave_type='Casual'.
expected_result: Leave request is accepted as Casual leave type without error.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports Restricted leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with Restricted leave balance.
action_or_input: Submit leave request specifying leave_type='Restricted'.
expected_result: Leave request is accepted as Restricted leave type without error.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports Medical leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with Medical leave balance.
action_or_input: Submit leave request specifying leave_type='Medical'.
expected_result: Leave request is accepted as Medical leave type without error.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports Earned leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with Earned leave balance.
action_or_input: Submit leave request specifying leave_type='Earned'.
expected_result: Leave request is accepted as Earned leave type without error.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports Vacation leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with Vacation leave balance.
action_or_input: Submit leave request specifying leave_type='Vacation'.
expected_result: Leave request is accepted as Vacation leave type without error.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports Sabbatical leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Authenticated eligible Faculty Employee with Sabbatical leave eligibility.
action_or_input: Submit leave request specifying leave_type='Sabbatical'.
expected_result: Leave request is accepted as Sabbatical leave type without error.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a leave request when valid leave type is specified.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with valid leave_type parameter provided alongside duration and justification.
expected_result: Validation succeeds and leave request is accepted.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS requires leave type and rejects leave requests where leave type is omitted.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request payload omitting the leave_type field.
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request) stating leave type is required.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a leave request when valid leave duration is specified.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with explicit valid duration (e.g. start_date, end_date, total_days=3).
expected_result: Validation succeeds and leave request duration is recorded.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS requires leave duration and rejects leave requests where duration is omitted or empty.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request payload omitting leave duration (or invalid date span).
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request) stating duration is required.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a leave request when valid justification is specified.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request including a non-empty justification string.
expected_result: Validation succeeds and leave request is accepted.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS requires justification and rejects leave requests where justification is omitted or blank.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request payload with justification omitted or empty string.
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request) stating justification is required.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a leave request submission when requested duration is within available leave balance.
preconditions: Employee has 10 days of Casual leave balance.
action_or_input: Employee submits Casual leave request for 3 days.
expected_result: Leave balance validation passes; request is accepted and queued for approval.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS validates leave balance and rejects leave requests where duration exceeds available balance.
preconditions: Employee has 2 days of Casual leave balance.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit Casual leave request for 5 days.
expected_result: Request is rejected before acceptance with error indicating insufficient leave balance (400 Bad Request).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a leave request when employee meets eligibility criteria for the requested leave type.
preconditions: Permanent faculty member eligible for Sabbatical leave.
action_or_input: Submit Sabbatical leave request meeting eligibility criteria.
expected_result: Eligibility validation passes and request is accepted.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS validates leave eligibility and rejects requests from employees not eligible for the requested leave type.
preconditions: Contractual employee ineligible for Sabbatical leave.
action_or_input: Contractual employee attempts to submit Sabbatical leave request.
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error indicating ineligibility for requested leave type.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes leave requests through a predefined approval hierarchy.
preconditions: Leave request submitted by Faculty employee.
action_or_input: Observe initial routing of submitted leave request.
expected_result: Request routes to the predefined hierarchy authority (HOD) for that employee category and leave type.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS updates employee leave balances automatically when leave is approved.
preconditions: Employee has 10 days Casual leave; pending 3-day Casual leave request awaiting final approval.
action_or_input: Approving Authority approves the leave request.
expected_result: Employee Casual leave balance is automatically reduced from 10 to 7 in the service record.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS permanently logs all leave transactions.
preconditions: Leave request created, approved, or rejected in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Query transaction/audit log for the leave request ID.
expected_result: Detailed audit entries exist for submission, review, approval, and balance adjustments.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Employees to submit yearly appraisal forms within active submission window.
preconditions: Active yearly appraisal submission window; authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Employee submits completed yearly appraisal form payload.
expected_result: Appraisal form is accepted with status 'Submitted' (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts yearly appraisal form submission within configured submission window.
preconditions: Current date is within configured start and end dates of the appraisal submission window.
action_or_input: Employee submits appraisal form within the active window.
expected_result: Submission is accepted successfully.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS restricts yearly appraisal form submission to configured submission windows and rejects submissions outside window.
preconditions: Current date is past the configured appraisal window deadline (closed window).
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit yearly appraisal form when window is closed.
expected_result: Submission is rejected with error (400 Bad Request or 403 Forbidden) indicating submission window is closed.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows the HR Administrator to assign reviewers for appraisal evaluation.
preconditions: Submitted appraisal form awaiting reviewer assignment; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator assigns specific evaluators to the appraisal record.
expected_result: Reviewer assignment is saved, and reviewers are granted evaluation access.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes appraisal workflows through designated authorities for review and finalization.
preconditions: Assigned reviewers have submitted evaluations.
action_or_input: Workflow routes appraisal to designated finalizing authority (e.g. Director).
expected_result: Appraisal is queued for finalization decision by the designated authority.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS archives finalized appraisals in the employee service record.
preconditions: Appraisal approved and closed by final authority.
action_or_input: Query employee service record after appraisal finalization.
expected_result: Finalized appraisal report is archived and accessible in the employee's historical service record.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents modification of appraisal records after closure.
preconditions: Finalized and closed appraisal record.
action_or_input: Attempt to update, edit, or delete the closed appraisal record.
expected_result: Operation is rejected with 403 Forbidden or 400 Bad Request; closed appraisal remains immutable.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Employees to submit LTC advance requests using prescribed forms.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee eligible for LTC.
action_or_input: Employee submits LTC advance request using prescribed form attributes (block year, travel dates, advance amount requested).
expected_result: LTC advance request is accepted with status 'Submitted' (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Employees to submit LTC reimbursement requests using prescribed forms.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with journey completed.
action_or_input: Employee submits LTC reimbursement request with tickets and expense details on prescribed form.
expected_result: LTC reimbursement request is accepted with status 'Submitted' (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to verify LTC documentation.
preconditions: Submitted LTC request with attached travel documentation; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator inspects documents and marks documentation verified.
expected_result: Documentation verification status is updated and recorded in HR-EIS.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to verify LTC eligibility.
preconditions: Submitted LTC request; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator checks block year eligibility and confirms applicant entitlement.
expected_result: Eligibility verification status is updated and recorded in HR-EIS.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes verified LTC requests through the approval hierarchy.
preconditions: LTC request with documentation and eligibility verified by HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator completes verification step.
expected_result: Request advances in workflow and routes to the designated Approving Authority (e.g. Registrar or Director).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Accountant to process approved LTC claims for financial settlement recording.
preconditions: Approved LTC claim; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant processes claim for financial settlement.
expected_result: Accountant processing is saved; claim advances to settlement-ready state.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS records payment status for LTC claims.
preconditions: Settled LTC claim awaiting payment confirmation.
action_or_input: Record payment status update (e.g. 'Disbursed', reference ID, payment date) on the LTC claim.
expected_result: Payment status is stored on the claim and displayed in tracking views.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS links LTC payment status to payroll systems without modifying payroll rules.
preconditions: LTC claim payment recorded.
action_or_input: Synchronize payment status to external payroll linkage interface.
expected_result: Payment status link is established while external payroll rules remain unmodified.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS retains full audit history for rejected LTC requests.
preconditions: Pending LTC request.
action_or_input: Approving Authority rejects LTC request with comments.
expected_result: Request transitions to 'Rejected'; complete audit trail of submission, verification, and rejection reason is preserved.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS retains full audit history for returned LTC requests.
preconditions: Pending LTC request.
action_or_input: Authority returns LTC request for correction/clarification.
expected_result: Request transitions to 'Returned'; complete audit history including return notes is retained.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Employees to submit CPDA advance requests.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee eligible for CPDA.
action_or_input: Employee submits CPDA advance request with purpose, amount, and supporting documents.
expected_result: CPDA advance request is accepted with status 'Submitted' (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Employees to submit CPDA reimbursement requests.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with CPDA expenses incurred.
action_or_input: Employee submits CPDA reimbursement request with expenditure bills and details.
expected_result: CPDA reimbursement request is accepted with status 'Submitted' (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a CPDA request when purpose is specified.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request with explicit purpose string (e.g. 'International Conference Registration').
expected_result: Validation succeeds and CPDA request is accepted.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS requires purpose and rejects CPDA requests where purpose is omitted.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request payload with purpose omitted or empty.
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request) stating purpose is required.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a CPDA request when valid amount is specified.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request with valid positive numerical amount (e.g. 25000.00).
expected_result: Validation succeeds and amount is recorded.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS requires amount and rejects CPDA requests where amount is omitted or invalid.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request payload with amount omitted, null, or zero/negative.
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request) stating amount is required.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a CPDA request when supporting documents are included.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request with valid supporting document attachments/references.
expected_result: Validation succeeds and supporting documents are linked to the request.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS requires supporting documents and rejects CPDA requests where supporting documents are omitted.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request payload with supporting documents omitted or empty list.
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request) stating supporting documents are required.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to verify CPDA claims before approval routing.
preconditions: Submitted CPDA claim; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator verifies CPDA purpose, amount entitlement, and attachments.
expected_result: Claim verification is recorded; claim is approved for routing to approval authority.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS routes verified CPDA claims through approval routing.
preconditions: CPDA claim verified by HR Administrator.
action_or_input: Advance claim into approval hierarchy.
expected_result: Claim routes to the designated Approving Authority (e.g. HOD / Dean / Director) according to policy.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS allows Accountant to process approved CPDA claims.
preconditions: Approved CPDA claim; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant verifies financial details and marks claim processed for settlement.
expected_result: Claim settlement processing is recorded successfully.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS records CPDA disbursement details.
preconditions: Processed CPDA claim.
action_or_input: Record disbursement transaction details (voucher number, disbursement date, net amount paid).
expected_result: Disbursement details are saved on the claim record.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS makes CPDA disbursement records auditable.
preconditions: Disbursed CPDA claim in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Query audit logs for the CPDA disbursement transaction.
expected_result: Complete audit trail showing claim history, approving actors, and disbursement details is retrieved.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS notifies an Employee about relevant HR request events and policy/deadline events.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with notifications enabled.
action_or_input: Trigger request status change and policy announcement for the employee.
expected_result: Notifications are generated and visible in the Employee's notification list.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS generates notifications for request submission.
preconditions: Employee submits an HR request.
action_or_input: Execute request submission.
expected_result: System creates submission confirmation notification for the applicant and action notification for the next reviewer.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS generates notifications for approval, rejection, or forwarding events.
preconditions: Pending request assigned to Approving Authority.
action_or_input: Authority approves, rejects, or forwards the request.
expected_result: System generates corresponding decision notification to applicant and relevant workflow parties.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS generates notifications for pending action reminders.
preconditions: Actionable request has remained pending beyond the configured reminder threshold.
action_or_input: Trigger reminder processing for aging pending requests.
expected_result: Reminder notification is generated and delivered to the pending authority.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS generates notifications for policy or deadline updates.
preconditions: Appraisal window deadline configured or updated in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Publish a deadline announcement or policy update in HR-EIS.
expected_result: Deadline notification is generated for all applicable employee accounts.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS delivers notifications through the system dashboard.
preconditions: Generated notifications in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Query dashboard notification feed API for the authenticated user.
expected_result: Dashboard notification items are returned with title, message, timestamp, and read status.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS dispatches notifications through the official email integration interface.
preconditions: Generated notification with email delivery flag.
action_or_input: Process notification dispatch queue.
expected_result: Notification is passed to the email service with recipient official email address and message body.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS logs every HR transaction.
preconditions: Transactional operations executed in HR-EIS (create, update, approve, reject, disburse).
action_or_input: Execute an HR transaction and query the audit subsystem.
expected_result: An audit log record is created for the transaction.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS audit logs include actor identity.
preconditions: Authenticated user performs an HR transaction.
action_or_input: Inspect the audit log entry created for the transaction.
expected_result: Audit entry explicitly records the actor ID/username who executed the action.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS audit logs include a valid timestamp.
preconditions: HR transaction executed at a known system time.
action_or_input: Inspect the audit log entry created for the transaction.
expected_result: Audit entry contains an accurate ISO timestamp of when the action occurred.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS audit logs include the action performed.
preconditions: HR transaction executed (e.g. 'APPROVE_LEAVE', 'UPDATE_SERVICE_RECORD').
action_or_input: Inspect the audit log entry created for the transaction.
expected_result: Audit entry explicitly details the specific action performed and impacted entity.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS audit logs are immutable and reject modification or deletion attempts.
preconditions: Existing audit log record in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to execute PUT, PATCH, or DELETE operation on an audit log record.
expected_result: Operation is rejected (403 Forbidden or 405 Method Not Allowed); audit record remains immutable.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS restricts audit log access to authorized roles only and blocks unauthorized users.
preconditions: Authenticated regular Employee session and HR Administrator session.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to query audit log endpoint; HR Administrator queries audit log endpoint.
expected_result: Employee query is refused with 403 Forbidden; HR Administrator query is permitted (200 OK).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports compliance with institutional HR and financial policies through logged HR-EIS transactions.
preconditions: Logged transactions across leave, appraisal, LTC, and CPDA.
action_or_input: Generate compliance query report aggregating logged lifecycle actions for an employee or department.
expected_result: Complete chronologically consistent transaction history is returned providing full regulatory traceability.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS integrates with the payroll system for disbursement-status exchange related to approved claims.
preconditions: Approved LTC/CPDA claim in HR-EIS; simulated payroll status interface.
action_or_input: Exchange claim disbursement status payload with the payroll system.
expected_result: Disbursement status exchange payload is validated and recorded without claiming payroll execution ownership.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS integrates with the finance system for accounting-status exchange related to approved claims.
preconditions: Approved LTC/CPDA claim in HR-EIS; simulated finance system interface.
action_or_input: Exchange accounting status payload with the finance system.
expected_result: Accounting status is recorded in HR-EIS without executing external finance-system ledger postings.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS integrates with other Fusion modules for identity and role consistency.
preconditions: Core user identity and role assignment updated in Fusion IAM.
action_or_input: Synchronize and query user identity/role context within HR-EIS.
expected_result: HR-EIS reflects consistent user identity and role context across Fusion modules.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS synchronizes integration data automatically and in real time where configured.
preconditions: Real-time integration webhook or event handler configured for claim status updates.
action_or_input: Trigger status event from integration endpoint.
expected_result: HR-EIS automatically updates claim state in real time upon event receipt.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS does not modify payroll rules.
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke any action or endpoint to alter external payroll calculation rules via HR-EIS.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects or disallows operation; payroll rule configuration is outside HR-EIS boundary and cannot be modified.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS does not modify salary structures.
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke any action or endpoint to alter institute salary grade or pay scale structures via HR-EIS.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects or disallows operation; salary structures remain outside HR-EIS and cannot be modified.
